sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 200% of max HP.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK and MATK by 80% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases wind elemental attack by 5 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases wind elemental defense by 30 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Increases max HP by 100% for 90 seconds.
Boosts stats of wind Monsters by 10% when equipped in the Main Slot.
